title: pbras-bsub-coculture-rnaseq: analysis code for Penicillium brasilianum RNA-seq in co-culture with Bacillus subtilis
description: Analysis code and processed count data for the RNA-seq comparison of Penicillium brasilianum SFC20200506-M13 co-cultured with wild-type Bacillus subtilis DK1042 versus the bacillibactin-deficient delta-dhbF mutant. Includes differential expression, gene set testing and quality control scripts, the processed HTSeq count tables and the annotation files needed to reproduce the reported results.
